notes.title: Patch Note | EA 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Enemies

- Modified non-boss enemies to change they attack one by one.


Item

- Changed the attack using Great swords. (2 times -> 1 time + 1 time automatically)


UI

- Changed the indicator when you get an item.
- Changed the UI in the inventory.

notes.title: Patch Note | EA 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Enemies

- Decreased HP (Every enemies). Changes due to reduced weapon attack capability


Weapons

- Decreased Attack Power (Every weapons). It will make the game easier.
- Third grade weapon's effects have changed.


Others

- Added Version Indicator
- Fixed a bug where enemies did not wear weapons.
- Fixed that could not be reduced volume to a minimum.
